summary: The missing source bank is restored. The exact batch still has a 2/2 matrix-free shortcut within its repeated q-72858 subgroup; revise batch selection. Math, native grading, rendering and packaging pass; package files stayed unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Identify which of five elementary row operations changes a specified entry of a 3 by 3 integer coefficient matrix to zero.
reasoning_steps: Read target row and column from a_ij.
Evaluate candidate row operations, rejecting operations that leave a nonzero target unchanged or do not cancel it.
Select the unique listed successful operation; worked solution applies that operation to the whole matrix.
invariants: One elementary row operation; no multi-step elimination or solving a system.
Nonzero scaling and distinct rows for row addition.
Exactly one valid listed choice achieves the stated target.
Prompt, correct bank entry, full-row arithmetic and explanation agree.
permitted_variations: All target coordinates and donor/recipient assignments may vary if prompt and dependencies follow.
Signed small integer entries, integer and simple fractional cancellation factors, matrix letter and option order may vary.
The successful listed donor and factor must be determined by entries rather than fixed labels or template signatures.
Distinct candidate row-addition options can exchange correctness when the relevant matrix entry changes while the rest stays fixed.
Non-target columns and matrix name are irrelevant to the selected operation and may change without changing the response.

source_replay.details: All 11 supplied five-choice banks replay. Restored q-72858 retains subtraction and both self-scaling expressions; original result row [4,3,0] is correct. Prior source correction and inferred incomplete-key completion retained. Author regression demonstrably fails on old package and passes current relocated copy.

math.details: Independent exact Fraction application verifies all five operations, unique keys and full result matrices for 55 fresh samples, five raw runner records, five counterfactuals and eleven source replays, plus all five normalized survivors. Earlier unchanged-family evidence reused with explicit equality binding.

variety.details: The restored generator supports both eligible winners at all nine targets, and ten complete banks are sampled. However the exact delivered batch repeats the recognizable q-72858 bank twice with the same sole distinct-row addition winning both; its finite subpool lacks a counterexample to the matrix-free action cue.

scope.details: Restored subtraction, nonzero self-scalings and eligible swaps preserve the source single-operation skill, 3x3 integer matrix, zero target and five radio choices. The incomplete unrated q-20392 remains explicit inferred replay only.

grading.details: Native grade_field accepted 28 independently verified correct selections and rejected 112 distractors, including all five post-normalization batch records and both relevant/irrelevant controlled pairs. No unresolved outcomes. Free-entry equivalence is inapplicable to this radio contract.

rendering.details: All eleven actual-UI renders pass and screenshots were inspected, including all five delivered records and controlled pairs. Matrices, fractions, indices, controls and worked results display correctly. UI order does not remove the operation-shape shortcut.

packaging.details: Exact Python 3.13.5, sympy 1.14.0 and mpmath 1.3.0 match the manifest. Deterministic replay, relocated CLI, JSON-only output, invalid-instance rejection and package immutability pass. No external assets or outputs are produced.

decision_variation.details: Relevant donor/target changes switch correct operations; irrelevant column changes preserve them. Conditional probes cover ten banks. All 55 fresh and five batch items survive actual delivery. The exact repeated q-72858 subpool admits a 2/2 matrix-free shortcut, versus 17/34 fresh controls. This is a delivered-batch failure, not a universal generator failure. Captured inventory and conditional learner-selection limits are explicit.

findings.description: The exact delivered batch contains two q-72858 instances (delivered IDs 966cbd2b-509b-557c-934a-d13f8e717b40 and dff0b0b0-a267-56e5-b263-a3394f910237). Both banks visibly contain two swaps, two self-scaling distractors and one distinct-row subtraction. Selecting that sole distinct-row operation answers both without reading any matrix entry or target. Fresh controls give 17/34 for the same cue, so this is a finite batch-selection defect; the generator supports the necessary swap counterexamples. Other batch templates are not alleged defective from singleton outcomes.
